story: You are a researcher at the University of California, Berkeley, conducting a longitudinal study called 'The Pathways to Well-being Project'. This study aims to collect comprehensive data on various aspects of individuals' lives to understand how different factors influence well-being over time. Participants provide information on their education level, employment status, marital status, income, health insurance, lifestyle choices, and more, helping to paint a detailed picture of their daily lives and experiences.
